<style class="gs-skin">
/* Skin band — single owner of:
   1) the gs- design tokens (defined exactly once page-wide);
   2) the shared primitives (.gs-sec/.gs-wrap/.gs-h2/.gs-lead/.gs-btn) the content sections
      consume — dropping this band unstyles them;
   3) site-chrome recolors, the same deliberate-chrome-layer class as 05-style rules 1-3;
      validate.py warns once, expected.
   Contrast (computed 2026-08-16): --gs7-muted #4E5748 is 7.55 on white and 7.2 on #F4F8EE
   (it replaced #697260 at 5.03); white on #3F6B39 6.22 AA; white on #4E8046 4.67 AA;
   #2C4E28 on #DCEBC4 7.51 AAA; #2C4E28 on the #F4F8EE footer wash 8.9. Gold #E0A73C never
   carries text on light (2.15) and is decorative-only.
   The .gs-reveal scroll-in utility and its script were removed with the rest of the page's
   animation; .gs-imgbox / .gs-tag went with the emoji tiles they served, now that every
   picture on the page is a real photograph. */
:root{
  --gs-sp-1:4px;--gs-sp-2:8px;--gs-sp-3:12px;--gs-sp-4:16px;--gs-sp-5:24px;
  --gs-sp-6:32px;--gs-sp-7:48px;--gs-sp-8:64px;
  --gs-r-btn:999px;--gs-r-input:12px;--gs-r-card:22px;--gs-r-big:26px;--gs-r-pill:999px;
  --gs-sh-card:0 14px 30px -18px rgba(32,39,26,.22);
  --gs-sh-raised:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(32,39,26,.35);
  --gs-sh-bar:0 -4px 20px rgba(32,39,26,.12);
  --gs-fs-h2:clamp(2.125rem,8vw,3.5rem);
  --gs-fs-h3:1.375rem;--gs-fs-lead:1.1875rem;--gs-fs-body:1.0625rem;--gs-fs-sm:.9375rem;--gs-fs-xs:.8125rem;
  --gs-display:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --gs-text:"Museo Sans Cyrl",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  --gs7-soft:#F4F8EE;--gs7-spring:#DCEBC4;--gs7-spring2:#C3DF9C;
  --gs7-green:#3F6B39;--gs7-green2:#4E8046;--gs7-deep:#2C4E28;
  --gs7-ink:#20271A;--gs7-muted:#4E5748;--gs7-gold:#E0A73C;--gs7-line:rgba(32,39,26,.14);
}
.gs-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.gs-sec{padding:56px 0;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.gs-sec--soft{background:var(--gs7-soft,#F4F8EE)}
.gs-center{text-align:center}
.gs-h2{margin:0 0 16px;font:800 var(--gs-fs-h2,2.125rem)/1.04 var(--gs-display,system-ui,sans-serif);
  letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--gs7-ink,#20271A);text-wrap:balance}
.gs-lead{margin:0;font:500 var(--gs-fs-lead,1.1875rem)/1.5 var(--gs-text,sans-serif);
  color:var(--gs7-muted,#4E5748);max-width:42ch}
.gs-center .gs-lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.gs-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:50px;
  padding:14px 26px;border-radius:var(--gs-r-pill,999px);background:var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);
  color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font:700 1rem/1.05 var(--gs-text,sans-serif);
  box-shadow:0 12px 24px -12px var(--gs7-deep,#2C4E28)}
.gs-btn:hover,.gs-btn:focus{background:var(--gs7-green2,#4E8046);color:#fff}
.gs-btn--big{min-height:58px;padding:18px 34px;font-size:1.0625rem}
.gs-btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);
  border:1.5px solid var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);box-shadow:none}
.gs-btn--ghost:hover,.gs-btn--ghost:focus{background:var(--gs7-soft,#F4F8EE);color:var(--gs7-deep,#2C4E28)}
@media (min-width:1024px){.gs-sec{padding:88px 0}}
/* --- site chrome recolors (deliberate, same layer class as 05-style rules 1-3) --- */
.sf-green-btn--classic{background:#3F6B39;color:#fff;border-radius:999px}
.sf-green-btn--classic:hover{background:#4E8046;color:#fff}
.l-title{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:#20271A}
.l-title::after{display:none}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-button{font-weight:700;color:#20271A;font-size:1.0625rem}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-button:not(.collapsed){background:#DCEBC4;color:#2C4E28;box-shadow:none}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-button:focus{border-color:#3F6B39;box-shadow:0 0 0 .25rem rgba(63,107,57,.25)}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-body{color:#4E5748}
/* Footer: client.css:1990 paints .sf-footer__title lime #C4F139, which on the footer's own
   #F4F8EE wash is about 1.5:1 — the section headings were effectively unreadable. Deep green
   #2C4E28 takes them to 8.9. Same swap for the lime hover states and for the logo and the
   contact icons, which are lime `fill`/`stroke` presentation attributes on the SVGs. */
.sf-footer{background:#F4F8EE}
.sf-footer__title{color:#2C4E28}
.sf-footer__text{color:#20271A}
.sf-footer__menu-item:hover,a.sf-footer__link:hover span{color:#2C4E28}
.sf-footer svg [fill="#C4F139"]{fill:#2C4E28}
.sf-footer svg [stroke="#C4F139"]{stroke:#2C4E28}
</style>
